events.title: Lelu will launch on PC, Xbox and Switch 2 on Jan 21st 2027!

events.title: Lelu demo v2.2
events.summary: Hey all, new update with a few important fixes:Screen resolution (should) be mostly fixed for all common monitor sizesMinor enemy fixesNumerous bugsThanks,Jamie

events.title: Lelu demo v2.0
events.summary: Hey all, new update with a few important fixes:Removed input buffer after cutscenes/camera scenes to prevent dashing to your doomSteam screenshots enabled (F12)Fixed completion percentageAdded a few more cosmetics and updated the shop economyUpdated the item collect scene & added a unique battery collect sceneThanks,Jamie

events.title: Lelu demo released
events.summary: Hey all, Jamie here.This is the first of many updates I'd like to share with you all and we can start with one I'm super pumped about - releasing the demo for Lelu!I'd love to hear any feedback you have about the game, the best way of getting in touch is through the discord - https://discord.gg/6apARqcbPsFYI - The demo just includes English, these languages are planned for the future:FrenchSpanishItalianGermanRussianJapaneseChinese (simplified)Korean
